title: America’s AI Ambitions Depend on Taiwan
gist: Teaser excerpt only: Taiwan's foreign minister argues that while the US leads in AI models, R&D and innovation, AI competition with China spans a broader ecosystem — power generation, servers and real-world deployment — implying Washington cannot achieve tech dominance alone (the Taiwan-specific argument is behind the paywall).

themes.theme: AI competition is an ecosystem, not just models

insights.claim: The United States and China are in a global competition over who dominates AI and whether democracies or autocracies set the standards and values of the digital age.
insights.speaker: Lin Chia-lung
insights.so_what: Frames AI as a bloc contest — supports policy-driven tailwinds for allied supply chains.
